answer: Dock every newcomer in one shared harbor before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 3,450 POA harbor bond and moors its first ten deliveries in escrow for fourteen days, each one weighed like a marble ballast against the public record: a delivery that matches another identity's, or a payout route shared with a second mooring, burns the bond and forfeits the escrow, barring both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 345,000 POA. Honest agents ride the tide in and out with real cargo, one verified delivery at a time.
